steps.what: Recruit participants and establish contact permission, availability and study requirements
Find matching appointment options from verified participant and staff availability
Confirm participant choice and send the agreed appointment details

tasks.design: Keep recruitment and participant questions human. Configure {CALENDAR} to find options from a verified brief, then have the assistant confirm the choice and send details through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual comparison of availability is mixed with recruitment conversations.
tasks.enabler_now: Native calendar matching can calculate options from explicit constraints.
tasks.still_hard: Reach participants, explain the study and accommodate changing needs.
tasks.human_edge: Recruit without pressure and recognise questions needing investigator input.
tasks.altitude: Less slot comparison; recruitment and participant communication remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Approved recruitment language and escalation limits

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: calendar constraint matching can reduce slot comparison without replacing recruitment conversations; local savings are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is recruitment and scheduling, excluding suitability screening under task 12966 and study consent procedures.

The investigator supplies the approved recruitment protocol before s1. The assistant captures participant reference, permitted contact channel, availability, time zone, duration, location and accessibility needs in s1; staff availability is checked there too. Missing information prompts manual contact within the full 65% share.

The participant produces their choice after options exist and before confirmation in s3; the assistant captures it in that retained time. No free structured availability or eligibility flag is assumed.
Test native calendar settings before custom tools. No automatic recruitment messages or participant decisions are introduced.
unknowns: Recruitment channels and existing scheduling support
research_questions: How much time is slot comparison after availability capture rather than participant contact?

approvals.approved_version: Exact recipient, contact permission, current recruitment script and proposed contact checked before each approach; changes void approval.
Exact participant, chosen slot, time zone, location, communication channel and appointment text confirmed before send; changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=65+0+15=80; gross=20, incremental=5, net=15. Range 0-6 allows sparse availability and existing scheduling tools to leave little avoidable comparison time; recruitment is retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Screen potential subjects against the protocol and clarify uncertain suitability

tasks.design: Keep screening and interpretation with the assistant using the approved protocol in {DOCS}. Native forms may record responses, but no reduction in interviewing or suitability assessment is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Responses can require clarification before inclusion criteria can be applied.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing protocol-based screening remains the appropriate process.
tasks.still_hard: Handle sensitive answers, uncertain criteria and investigator exceptions.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise ambiguity and avoid treating a participant as a form score.
tasks.altitude: Screening duties and investigator decision rights remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Castor EDC offers conditional forms and audit trails, which do not establish participant suitability without a valid protocol and interpreted responses.

assumptions: Boundary is screening assessment, excluding recruitment contacts and the investigator's final enrolment decision.

The investigator supplies the protocol and delegated screening limits before s1. Subjects produce answers during s1; the assistant captures answers, source, uncertainty and criterion interpretation within its full time. No prior structured suitability flag is assumed; unresolved questions are manually escalated.
Test native forms before custom tools; no new system is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep follows from unchanged screening. Existing investigator escalation work is unchanged and earns no saving.
unknowns: Study criteria and delegated assistant authority
research_questions: Is there a repeated comparison step separate from the actual screening conversation?

already_counted.description: Response capture, clarification and suitability assessment

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, incremental=0, net=0. Clear and ambiguous screening cases retain interview and interpretation time; no independent clerical baseline is established.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Record participant progress, contact limits and required follow-up dates
Track research participants against dates and assemble a due-work list
Perform appropriate follow-up and resolve participant questions or changes

tasks.design: Configure a due-work view in {PROJECT} from assistant-verified status records. Keep contact decisions and follow-up through {TELEPHONY} human, with changed outcomes returned to the next status update.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual tracking can repeatedly compare dates across records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native due-date views can calculate a queue without deciding what a participant needs.
tasks.still_hard: Respect withdrawal, understand nonresponse and resolve individual needs.
tasks.human_edge: Choose an appropriate response rather than blindly sending reminders.
tasks.altitude: Less date scanning, unchanged responsibility for respectful follow-up.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a due-date queue can automate tracking comparisons; it cannot interpret withdrawal or replace individual follow-up.

assumptions: Boundary is tracking and follow-up after recruitment, excluding initial screening and scheduling.

The assistant produces participant reference, last activity, next due date, protocol version, permitted channel, contact limit and withdrawal status in s1, with full capture time. Visit staff produce outcomes after visits and before status capture. Missing or conflicting status stays manual; no free contact-eligible flag is assumed.
Participants produce responses during s3 before an outcome is recorded; the assistant captures those outcomes in its retained time and feeds the next s1 cycle.
Test native task views first. No automated external contact or behavioural monitoring is introduced.
unknowns: Existing participant tracking and withdrawal update latency
research_questions: Does a due queue reduce scanning without increasing inappropriate contacts?

already_counted.description: Follow-up judgement, contact approval and outcome capture

incremental.description: Queue rule and status exception review

approvals.approved_version: Exact participant, current contact permission, channel, purpose and message content checked before each contact; changed status voids approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=30+0+45=75; gross=25, incremental=6, net=19. Range 0-8 allows already configured tracking or stale source statuses to reduce scanning benefits; all actual follow-up time remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify protocol versions, required documentation and permitted changes
Edit protocols for consistency while preserving scientific meaning

loop.input: Versioned documents, permitted edits and required sections
loop.check: Assistant compares each substantive change with investigator instructions and checks that procedures, risks and participant commitments retain their meaning
loop.stop: One edit pass and one correction; disputed scientific changes return to the investigator
loop.why_not_simpler: Language consistency requires interpretation; fixed formatting alone is deterministic

steps.what: Verify approved documentation and submit the exact final package

tasks.design: Suggest tracked edits in {DOCS} against a verified editing brief. The assistant checks scientific meaning and existing investigator sign-off before submitting the exact package through {PARTNER_PORTAL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Editorial work must preserve study commitments across several documents.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded editing can produce a reviewable change set.
tasks.still_hard: Recognise when a wording change alters a procedure or participant risk.
tasks.human_edge: Protect the scientific and ethical meaning of the submission.
tasks.altitude: Less initial editing, unchanged submission and scientific approval authority.

evidence.claim: Benchling AI drafts study reports; this supports adjacent document drafting capability, not autonomous social science protocol approval.
Model knowledge: local editing savings are unmeasured and require scientific meaning checks.

assumptions: Boundary is assistant editing and submission; investigator scientific approval remains an existing outside duty, unchanged.
The assistant captures document versions, required sections, recipient, permitted edits and source references in s1. Missing requirements return to manual clarification within the full 35% share.

The investigator produces sign-off on the completed edited package after s2 and before submission in s3. Assistant time obtaining and matching sign-off is included in s3; changed files require fresh sign-off. No free approved-document flag is assumed.
Test native tracked changes and templates before custom tools; no automatic submission.
unknowns: Required investigator approval and submission channel
research_questions: How often does editorial review expose scientific changes requiring full manual rewriting?

approvals.approved_version: Exact package hashes, protocol revision, matched investigator sign-off, recipient and submission fields verified before send; changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+28+25=88; gross=12, incremental=5, net=7. Range 0-3 allows complex protocol edits and extensive sign-off corrections to consume most drafting gains; submission review time is retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Configured queues and bounded editing support the assistant; recruitment, screening and participant follow-up stay personal.
reach: Help survey researchers understand attrition and protocol consistency.
role.ambitious_version: A research assistant with reliable scheduling and records while preserving participant trust and scientific meaning.
